H7200.def: a primitive root; to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative):--advise self, appear, approve, behold, × certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, × indeed, × joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, × be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), × sight of others, (e-)spy, stare, × surely, × think, view, visions.

H7201.def: from «07200»; a bird of prey (probably the vulture, from its sharp sight):--glede. Compare «01676».

H7203.def: active participle of «07200»; a seer (as often rendered); but also (abstractly) a vision:--vision.

H7204.def: for «07203»; prophet; Roeh, an Israelite:--Haroeh (including the article).

H7205.def: from the imperative of «07200» and «01121»; see ye a son; Reuben, a son of Jacob:--Reuben.

H7206.def: patronymic from «07205»; a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben:--children of Reuben, Reubenites.

H7208.def: feminine passive participle of «07213»; raised; Reumah, a Syrian woman:--Reumah.

H7210.def: from «07200»; sight, whether abstractly (vision) or concretely (a spectacle):--gazingstock, look to, (that) see(-th).

H7211.def: from «07200» and «03050»; Jah has seen; Reajah, the name of three Israelites:--Reaia, Reaiah.

H7213.def: a primitive root; to rise:--be lifted up.

H7214.def: or rieym {reh-ame'}; or reym {rame}; or rem {rame}; from «07213»; a wild bull (from its conspicuousness):--unicorn.

H7215.def: from «07213»; something high in value, i.e. perhaps coral:--coral.

H7216.def: or Ramoth {raw-moth'}; plural of «07215»; heights; Ramoth, the name of two places in Palestine:--Ramoth.

H7217.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07218»; the head; figuratively, the sum:--chief, head, sum.

H7218.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to shake
H7218.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to shake; the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.):--band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, × every (man), excellent, first, forefront, ((be-))head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), × lead, × poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

H7219.def: or rowsh (Deut. 32:32) {roshe}; apparently the same as «07218»; a poisonous plant, probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents):--gall, hemlock, poison, venom.

H7220.def: probably the same as «07218»; Rosh, the name of an Israelite and of a foreign nation:--Rosh.

H7221.def: from the same as «07218»; a beginning:--beginning.

H7223.def: or riishon {ree-shone'}; from «07221»; first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun):--ancestor, (that were) before(-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore(-father) (-most), former (thing), of old time, past.

H7225.def: from the same as «07218»; the first, in place, time, order or rank (specifically, a firstfruit):--beginning, chief(-est), first(-fruits, part, time), principal thing.

H7226.def: from «07218»; a pillow (being for the head):--bolster.

H7227.def: by contracted from «07231»; abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality):--(in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), ((ship-))master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

H7228.def: by contraction from «07232»; an archer (or perhaps the same as «07227»):--archer.

H7229.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07227»:--captain, chief, great, lord, master, stout.

H7230.def: from «07231»; abundance (in any respect):--abundance(- antly), all, × common (sort), excellent, great(-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty(-ifully), × very (age).

H7231.def: a primitive root; properly, to cast together (compare «07241»), i.e. increase, especially in number; also (as denominative from «07233») to multiply by the myriad:--increase, be many(-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands.

H7232.et: a primitive root [rather identical with (07231) through the idea of projection]
H7232.def: a primitive root (rather identical with «07231» through the idea of projection); to shoot an arrow:--shoot.

H7233.def: from «07231»; abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite):--many, million, × multiply, ten thousand.

H7235.def: a primitive root; to increase (in whatever respect):--(bring in) abundance (X -antly), + archer (by mistake for «07232»), be in authority, bring up, × continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding(-ly), be full of, (be, make) great(-er, -ly, × -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty(-eous), × process (of time), sore, store, thoroughly, very.

H7236.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07235»:--make a great man, grow.

H7237.def: feminine of «07227»; great; Rabbah, the name of two places in Palestine, East and West:--Rabbah, Rabbath.

H7238.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «07235»; increase (of dignity):--greatness, majesty.

H7239.def: from «07231»; or ribbow {rib-bo'} from «07231»; a myriad, i.e. indefinitely, large number:--great things, ten ((eight)-een, (for)-ty, + sixscore, + threescore, × twenty, (twen)-ty) thousand.

H7240.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07239»:--X ten thousand times ten thousand.

H7241.def: from «07231»; a rain (as an accumulation of drops):--shower.

H7242.def: from «07234»; a collar (as spread around the neck):--chain.

H7243.def: or rbiiy {reb-ee-ee'}; from «07251»; fourth; also (fractionally) a fourth:--foursquare, fourth (part).

H7245.def: from «07231»; multitude; Rabbith, a place in Palestine:--Rabbith.

H7246.def: a primitive root; to soak (bread in oil):--baken, (that which is) fried.

H7247.et: from an unused root meaning to be fruitful
H7247.def: from an unused root meaning to be fruitful; fertile; Riblah, a place in Syria:--Riblah.

H7248.et: from (07227) and a foreign word for a Magian
H7248.def: from «07227» and a foreign word for a Magian; chief Magian; Rab-Mag, a Bab. official:--Rab-mag.

H7249.et: from (07227) and a foreign word for a eunuch
H7249.def: from «07227» and a foreign word for a eunuch; chief chamberlain; Rab-Saris, a Babylonian official:--Rab-saris.

H7250.def: a primitive root; to squat or lie out flat, i.e. (specifically) in copulation:--let gender, lie down.

H7251.et: a primitive root [rather identical with (07250) through the idea of sprawling "at all fours" (or possibly the reverse is the order of deriv)
H7251.def: a primitive root (rather identical with «07250» through the idea of sprawling "at all fours" (or possibly the reverse is the order of deriv.); compare «0702»); properly, to be four (sided); used only as denominative of «07253»; to be quadrate:--(four-)square(-d).

H7253.def: from «07251»; a fourth (part or side):--fourth part, side, square.

H7254.def: the same as «07253»; Reba, a Midianite:--Reba.

H7256.def: from «07251»; a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild:--fourth.

H7257.def: a primitive root; to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed:--crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.

H7258.def: from «07257»; a couch or place of repose:--where each lay, lie down in, resting place.

H7259.et: from an unused root probably meaning to clog by tying up the fetlock
H7259.def: from an unused root probably meaning to clog by tying up the fetlock; fettering (by beauty); Ribkah, the wife of Isaac:-- Rebekah.

H7260.def: (Aramaic) from «07229»; huge (in size); domineering (in character):--(very) great (things).

H7262.def: from «07227» and «08248»; chief butler; Rabshakeh, a Bab. official:--Rabshakeh.

H7263.et: from an unused root meaning to pile together
H7263.def: from an unused root meaning to pile together; a lump of clay:--clod.

H7264.def: a primitive root; to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear):--be afraid, stand in awe, disquiet, fall out, fret, move, provoke, quake, rage, shake, tremble, trouble, be wroth.

H7267.def: from «07264»; commotion, restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet, anger:--fear, noise, rage, trouble(-ing), wrath.

H7270.def: a primitive root; to walk along; but only in specifically, applications, to reconnoiter, to be a tale-bearer (i.e. slander); also (as denominative from «07272») to lead about:--backbite, search, slander, (e-)spy (out), teach to go, view.

H7272.def: from «07270»; a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphem. the pudenda:--X be able to endure, × according as, × after, × coming, × follow, ((broken-))foot((-ed, -stool)), × great toe, × haunt, × journey, leg, + piss, + possession, time.

H7274.def: plural of active participle of «07270»; fullers (as tramping the cloth in washing); Rogelim, a place East of the Jordan:-- Rogelim.

H7275.def: a primitive root (compare «07263», «07321», «07551»); to cast together (stones), i.e. to lapidate:--X certainly, stone.

H7277.def: feminine of the same as «07276»; a pile (of stones), i.e. (figuratively) a throng:--council.

H7278.def: from «07276» and «04428»; king's heap; Regem-Melek, an Israelite:--Regem-melech.

H7279.def: a primitive root; to grumble, i.e. rebel:--murmur.

H7280.def: a primitive root; properly, to toss violently and suddenly (the sea with waves, the skin with boils); figuratively (in a favorable manner) to settle, i.e. quiet; specifically, to wink (from the motion of the eye-lids):--break, divide, find ease, be a moment, (cause, give, make to) rest, make suddenly.

H7281.et: from (07280) a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time
H7281.def: from «07280». a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time:--instant, moment, space, suddenly.

H7282.def: from «07280»; restful, i.e. peaceable:--that are quiet.

H7283.def: a primitive root; to be tumultuous:--rage.

H7285.def: or (feminine) rigshah {rig-shaw'}; from «07283»; a tumultuous crowd:--company, insurrection.

H7286.def: a primitive root; to tread in pieces, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer, or (specifically) to overlay:--spend, spread, subdue.

H7287.def: a primitive root; to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off:--(come to, make to) have dominion, prevail against, reign, (bear, make to) rule,(-r, over), take.

H7288.def: intensive from «07287»; domineering; Raddai, an Israelite:--Raddai.

H7289.et: from (07286) in the sense of spreading
H7289.def: from «07286» in the sense of spreading; a veil (as expanded):--vail, veil.

H7290.def: a primitive root; to stun, i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death):--(be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep(-er, -eth).

H7291.def: a primitive root; to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by):--chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).

H7292.def: a primitive root; to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently:--overcome, behave self proudly, make sure, strengthen.

H7294.def: the same as «07293»; Rahab (i.e. boaster), an epithet of Egypt:--Rahab.

H7297.def: a primitive root; to fear:--be afraid.

H7298.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to hollow out
H7298.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to hollow out; a channel or watering-box; by resemblance a ringlet of hair (as forming parallel lines):--gallery, gutter, trough.

H7299.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «07200»; aspect:--form.
